instruction: Open-choice CLI requirement: This environment provides three candidate engineering toolchains, including BIM-capable tools and a distractor tool. Choose an appropriate BIM-capable command-line or official automation workflow from these options to edit C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc and export the completed IFC4 deliverable as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside the selected BIM toolchain. The current model is a two-storey shared student house with bedrooms, shared kitchen, dining, lounge, laundry, and a courtyard. The client wants a quiet study room and a clearer laundry expansion record while preserving the shared social spaces, courtyard, roof, and bedroom count. Add the study and laundry support items so the residence management schedule separates quiet work from service activity.
source: Open-choice BIM environment; evaluation checks IFC deliverable semantics rather than the selected tool.
